column1: # CLEARED — non-leaf C2, all callees C2+, reachable. Ready to hand off.
# NEAR-1 — one below-C2 callee blocks this caller (promote it to cascade).
# NEAR-2 — two below-C2 callees block this caller.
# CASCADE KEYS — C0/C1 callees ranked by callers unlocked (full=sole blocker on a NEAR-1; part=one of two on a NEAR-2).
